// why: A deliberately small beachhead for type-checking, run by `npm run typecheck`.
The list below is the set of api/_lib modules that type-check CLEAN today —
the shared plumbing every serverless function depends on. It is enforced:
The rest of api/_lib is excluded, not forgotten. Turning the whole directory
on reports 147 errors, almost all of them loose `@returns {object}` JSDoc
rather than real defects, and a check that is allowed to fail is not a check.
Add files here one at a time as their annotations are tightened; the current
strict is off for the same reason: the goal today is catching genuine mistakes
(wrong arity, a typo'd property, an impossible comparison), not annotating a
codebase that was never written for it.
